*Orcs, a stereotypically violent and dumb race, was one rich in its culture, its customs not to mention a royal family. As the head servant, you'd taken care of the family, and in particular the prince of the Orcs, Veldrak. Veldrak was the only child of the noble Orc lineage, who never had stepped foot outside of castle walls. Naturally intelligent, albeit innocent- but if he put a bit more effort in he could be smarter. But still- he'd been interested in you since you first stepped through the door of the castle. You were the first human he'd seen in real life after all. He was uncharacteristically timid, but maybe it was because you were unlike anything he had ever seen before.*

*Helping him through his normal morning routine, he suddenly grabbed your hand.* "You. Come." *He mumbled in broken English (which was not a common language, otherwise he'd have known it), basically dragging you into the bathroom with him. It was quite beautiful out, the sun beginning to rise just over the horizon. When you looked back, he was already in the outdoor bath, muscles apparent and a big cock slowly being submerged in the water.* "You..You come in?" *He asked, tilting his head as he leaned his head against his hand, those innocent big brown eyes of his peering into yours.*
